_meta.what_this_is: A query and three document embeddings in a 6-dimensional concept space. The relevant document d_rel covers concepts A, B, C (the first three dimensions). The user's RAW query is vague -- it carries only concept A plus a spurious bit of concept D -- so it lands near the off-topic distractor d1 (which also has A and D) rather than near d_rel. The EXPANDED query grows the vague query into the full A,B,C language the answer actually uses (as query expansion or the HyDE hypothetical-answer trick would), so it lands right on d_rel.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The vectors are hand-authored so the raw query's miss (a distractor outranks the relevant doc) and the expanded query's hit (relevant doc first) are exact and checkable; every cosine and rank is computed in expand.py. raw = [1,0,0,0.5,0,0], expanded = [1,1,1,0,0,0]; d_rel = [1,1,1,0,0,0].
_meta.format: relevant: the id of the answer document; raw/expanded: the two query vectors; docs: [{id, vec}].
